messages:
maya: incident-bot didn't create pages for PagerDuty during the scheduled db-migrate window — spotted at ~10:12 UTC. critical-error spike in metrics and no PD incidents. anyone else seeing dropped pages?

incident-bot: Automated alert: incident created (INC-1962) — webhook delivery failed to PagerDuty (3 retries). Delivery errors logged: https://logs.internal/incident-bot/1962 

jin: I'm on it. grabbing webhook-proxy logs from prod-cluster-3 now.

sam: I tried a manual PD webhook (test key) from my laptop -> got 502 gateway. reproducing locally.

priya: dashboard shows webhook-proxy healthy (k8s liveness) but delivery_latency and 5xx_count spiking since 10:09 UTC.

maya: paging fallback engaged: I manually sent SMS to @alex — alex did you receive it?

alex: got SMS and ACKed. didn't receive bot page. Checked PD console: no incident created for the alerts that should have escalated.

jin: tailing proxy logs: 
```
2026-03-14T10:10:12Z proxy request POST /v2/enqueue 502 upstream_connect_error
2026-03-14T10:11:03Z proxy retry attempt=1 status=502
2026-03-14T10:12:45Z proxy healthcheck passed
```
looks like intermittent upstream resets to PagerDuty API from the proxy.

sam: I'm doing a rolling restart of webhook-proxy (kubectl -n infra rollout restart deploy/webhook-proxy). will monitor deliveries.

ops-bot: Restart requested by sam at 10:17 UTC — rollout started.

jin: after restart, I triggered a test webhook and PD shows the event at 10:18 UTC. delivery looks restored. need to backfill missing events and verify no customer-impacting alerts were lost.

maya: we compensated manually for oncall alerting. next steps: audit what alerts were missed (cross-check alertmanager and PD receipts) and notify affected customers if needed.

priya: quick query to get candidates: `alert_count{severity=\"critical\"} | since 10m` then correlate with PD incidents API.

sam: created a short-lived fallback in incident-bot to send SMS after 3 failed webhook attempts (temporary). PR: github.com/redwood/incident-bot/pull/482 — will need rush review.

maya: sticking items for post-incident: 1) add proxy-level circuit-breaker metrics and alerting, 2) improve webhook retry logging + include request id in logs, 3) deploy fallback route in incident-bot, 4) run a PD delivery chaos test, 5) customer-facing timeline if we discover any missed pages. tagging @sre-team. :exclamation:

pagerbot: Note — PagerDuty shows a gap from 10:09–10:17 UTC for our webhook keys. Manual pages were used during the gap.

maya: status: incident mitigated (manual pages + proxy restart). root cause suspected: transient upstream connectivity resets from proxy to PD API; follow-ups assigned. I'll open a postmortem draft and link the logs. Thanks everyone for the quick triage. :thumbsup:
